args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

@gideon.sato: Per this channel, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Your post says both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The next guard entry is Mateo's at 11:03 AM: kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch saw. Your 11:08 AM post says both lanes were working as of 11:07. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03, so if the postmortem needs more, check with the guard or the ticket INC-4821.
